summary: Content generated by LLMs is not allowed in code, documentation, pull requests, issues or comments. AI may be used to translate into English, to understand the codebase, or to help find bugs, as long as findings are verified before filing.

evidence.quote: Contributions must not include content generated by large language models or other probabilistic tools, including but not limited to Copilot or ChatGPT.
Yes, but you must verify the output of any AI tool before filing issues against the Servo project.
This policy covers code, documentation, pull requests, issues, comments, and any other contributions to the Servo project.
